messages.subject: Series A — engaging you for our raise
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to speak yesterday. As discussed, we'd like Whitfield Carter to act for Penrose Robotics on our Series A. Calderbrook Growth are leading with Aldridge Seed alongside; we're aiming to close in November.

Can you send across an engagement letter and a kick-off note on process? Aisha (CTO) and I will be your main contacts, plus Priya on finance.

Thanks,
Marcus

messages.subject: RE: Series A — engaging you for our raise
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Delighted to act. I'll have our engagement letter over to you tomorrow. James Osei (senior associate) and Elena Marchetti will work with me.

Initial process: (1) agree heads/term sheet with Calderbrook; (2) due diligence + data room; (3) long-form docs (subscription & shareholders' agreement, investor rights agreement, new articles, disclosure letter); (4) board/member approvals and completion.

Who is acting for Calderbrook? We'll open a dialogue with them early.

Best,
Sarah
